service.name: automated-annotation
service.description: Automated annotation service using agent architecture for classification tasks. Supports vector-based model classification and LLM-based property classification via orchestration handlers.

deployment._url_config_note: API URLs are now stage-aware and configured in stage_urls.py. URLs are selected based on STAGE env var (dev/staging/prod).
deployment._azure_pg_why: TP-461 (2026-10-19): taxonomy lookups read the Azure client box truss-client-pg (schema api on every stage) instead of Cloud SQL, which is being retired. Credentials come from truss-platform-secrets[AZURE_PG_SECRET_KEY] (azure_database_aifl = svc_aifl, its own PgBouncer pool so an annotation burst cannot queue in front of the API — Dan, 2026-10-19; azure_database = svc_dsl is the DSL role). 6432 = built-in PgBouncer. The box firewall is an IP allow-list, hence the VPC config below: egress leaves via NAT nat-0204ce6dd026389b7 (EIP 3.9.155.136).

vpc_config._why: TP-461: same RDS-Pvt private subnets + NAT EIP as the DSL Azure cutover (#98). Stack-owned egress SG; the Secrets Manager interface endpoint SG must admit it (endpoint_ingress_security_groups) or getSecretValue hangs.

api._note: Endpoints with paths starting with '/' are absolute (not relative to base_path). Endpoints without leading '/' are relative to base_path.

endpoints.description: Classify model using vector-based similarity search via model_vector_classifier_api_handler. Uses pre-computed image vectors from image-processing table, queries Pinecone for similar images, and performs majority voting. Returns model, model_id, root_model, root_model_id, and confidence.

body.image: string (required) - Processing/Image ID (processing_id) stored in the image-processing DynamoDB table. Signed image URL will be looked up automatically.
body.brand: string (required) - Brand namespace for Pinecone (e.g., 'jacquemus'). Uses 7 nearest neighbors by default

endpoints.description: Classify a property (type, material, colour, etc.) using the new agent architecture system via agent_orchestration_api_handler. Maps category/property to config_id, calls orchestration function, and returns formatted result with IDs and names.

body.image: string (optional) - Processing/Image ID. Signed image URL will be looked up automatically from annotation-data-service-layer.
body.image_url: string (optional) - Direct image URL (if already signed, takes precedence over image)
body.text_input: string (optional) - Pre-formatted text string (takes precedence if provided)
body.text_metadata: object (optional) - Text metadata as JSON dict (e.g., {"brand": "...", "title": "...", "description": "..."}). Allows column filtering before passing to agent.
body.text_dump: string (optional) - Legacy field - treated as text_input if provided (for backward compatibility)
body.brand: string (optional) - Brand name (used to build text_metadata dict if text_metadata not provided)
body.title: string (optional) - Title (used to build text_metadata dict if text_metadata not provided)
body.description: string (optional) - Description (used to build text_metadata dict if text_metadata not provided)

endpoints.description: Direct agent execution endpoint (INTERNAL USE ONLY - called by external orchestration scripts). ARCHITECTURE EXCEPTION: Directly calls agent_architecture (violates normal pattern). DEPRECATED: Will be removed once legacy systems are migrated. New code should use orchestration functions via agent_orchestration_api_handler.
endpoints._note: This endpoint is NOT under base_path /automations/annotation - it's a separate root-level endpoint

body.config_id: string (required) - Agent configuration ID from DynamoDB (e.g., 'material-30', 'classifier-material-bags')
body.input_data: object (required) - Task-specific input data: {item_id: string (required), image_url: string (optional), text_input: string (optional), input_mode: string (optional, default: 'auto')}

endpoints.description: Health check endpoint for the automated annotation service. Returns service status and stage information.

Generate CSV column mapping configuration using LLM analysis. Analyzes sample rows from a CSV file and produces a mapping that identifies brand, title, description, and image columns. Configs are cached in DynamoDB for reuse.

body.CSV_uuid: string (required) - Unique identifier for the CSV file
body.sample_rows: array (required) - List of 5-10 sample row dicts from the CSV
body.organisation_uuid: string (optional) - Organization scope for config lookup/storage
body.max_chars: integer (optional) - Maximum characters for sample data (default: 25000)
